## 💡 Feature Summary

> A short, one-line description of the feature you're proposing.

---

## 🎯 Problem Statement

> What problem does this solve? Who benefits from this feature?
>
> Example: *"As a learner, I want to see my historical XP trend so I can track my progress over time."*

---

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution

> A concrete description of how the feature would work from the user's perspective.

---

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

> What other approaches did you consider? Why is this one better?

---

## 📐 Scope Assessment

- [ ] **Small** — New Reactor quiz question(s) only
- [ ] **Medium** — Enhancement to an existing module (e.g., new badge, new pipeline step)
- [ ] **Large** — New module or significant architectural change
- [ ] **Breaking** — Requires changes to existing state schema or component interfaces

---

## 📊 Educational Value

> How does this feature improve the Git learning experience?

---

## 📝 Additional Context

> Add any other context, mockups, or references here.
